# The home hero draws the team at work, on an engine RoundTable scene

Leaf of #20682, for the Engine 14 cut of Mon Nov 23. Self-assigned and under way; no curated labels, because it is owned and dated.

## Context

The operator, Fri 2026-11-20, on the home's hero canvas: *"probably around February … Gemini (before getting the name Julia) created a Canvas based simulation that in many ways represents our AI team. What I am wondering about, now that models got a LOT smarter (multiple next generations) if we can do better here. This would fit well into the v14 scope. The idea of a simulation is still nice, and neo-stage is not ready yet to show own content in here."* And, the same hour, on the canvas of the Agent Institution app's home view (`neomjs/neo-agent-institution`, `apps/agentos/canvas/Home.mjs`): *"this looks more like a spider web with some hover animations and not a simulation. does not meet our current quality bar either."*

`ROADMAP.md` row 3 (#20682) is the frame: someone who has never seen Neo reads the home section and can say what Neo is, who it is for and what to do next.

## The Problem

**What the hero draws.** `Portal.canvas.HomeCanvas` is the "Neural Swarm" of `#8661`, built on 15 and 16 Jan 2026 (`#8662` to `#8698`, when the team was one unnamed model): 150 nodes, 20 "seeker drones", 20 packets, a shockwave on click. What they stand for ("components within containers", "the Neural Link", "atomic moves") is written in its JSDoc only. On screen nothing has a name. Rendered on `dev` `5cb81df00a` at 1440×900 in the boot theme (`neo-theme-neo-dark`): the logo, the headline, the sentence and two buttons over a navy field with a few faint specks, because its links draw at an alpha of at most 0.2. The cold readers of #20987 called the screen a "self-contained splash". The Agent Institution app's field is the same picture with one real input: a ring of marks, one per rostered agent, lit when up.

**What the hero says.** The sentence under the headline names four things: persistent AI maintainers with identities, memory, peer review, and a record anyone can read. The picture behind it shows none of them.

**What exists and is public.** `gh pr list --repo neomjs/neo --state merged --search "merged:2026-11-13T00:00:00Z..2026-11-20T13:50:00Z" --json number,author,createdAt,mergedAt,mergedBy,reviews`, read at 2026-11-20T13:55Z:

| | |
|---|---|
| Pull requests merged | 341, between 29 and 70 on each whole day |
| Their authors | 10 maintainer accounts in 3 model families (253), 40 outside accounts (68), Dependabot (20) |
| Reviews by another account, on the 321 that are not Dependabot's | 536, of them 353 `APPROVED` and 145 `CHANGES_REQUESTED` |
| Maintainer pull requests approved by a maintainer of another model family | 252 of 253 |
| Merged by | `tobiu` 321, the Dependabot workflow 20 |
| Median, opened to first review / to merge | 51 min / 149 min |

In January this had to be imagined. Now a simulation that invents its events is weaker than the record.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/canvas/HomeCanvas.mjs` (1,148 lines) extends `Neo.canvas.Base`: a singleton on the canvas worker with a 2D context. It sizes its buffer in CSS pixels (`updateSize`, line 1129), so text would be soft on a HiDPI screen; no renderer under `apps/portal/canvas/` draws text today.
- Its host `apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/Canvas.mjs` extends `Neo.app.SharedCanvas` (lifecycle, size with `devicePixelRatio`, pointer, theme, pause while hidden). `hero/Container.mjs` forwards the pointer from the whole hero and pauses the canvas when the hero page deactivates.
- The statement lies above the canvas (`hero/Content.mjs`). At 1440×900 the canvas is 1440×842 and the block spans y 251 to 713, the sentence x 370 to 1070. Free: a band above, the two sides, a band below.
- A renderer the engine owns lives in `src/canvas/`: `Header.mjs` with its host `src/app/header/Canvas.mjs`, and `GraphScene.mjs`, which the Agent Institution app's Observatory extends. `#19261` built `GraphScene` so that style arrives as input (no palette in the engine) and the math is exported as pure functions for unit arms. `buildScripts/util/check-consumer-runtime-build.mjs:226` (`CANVAS_EXPECTATIONS`) asserts that a workspace build's canvas worker reaches each of them in the package.
- `AgentOS.canvas.Home` (Vega, 2026-09-30) already solved three things this scene needs: the field goes quiet under the rects its host measures from the hero's lines (`setQuiet`), a still frame at a seeded rest layout for `prefers-reduced-motion` (`setMotion`, read from the engine's `--motion-base`, `resources/css/src/Global.css:49`), and a buffer at the host's pixel ratio. Its host carries the measuring (`apps/agentos/view/home/Canvas.mjs`).
- The Portal's data generators live in `buildScripts/docs/` (`captureExamples.mjs`) and write under `apps/portal/resources/data/`; the Portal reads that folder by a relative URL (`apps/portal/store/Releases.mjs:23`).

## The Fix

One engine scene, fed by a record. The Portal feeds it a dated replay of the public record; the Agent Institution app can feed it its own fleet (its own leaf, after the pin bump).

1. **`src/canvas/RoundTable.mjs`, `Neo.canvas.RoundTable`.** The scene: seats on an ellipse, each with a name, coloured by its group; one seat of kind `door`, where work from outside the table enters; one of kind `merge`. A pull request appears at its author's seat. Each review is a chord from the reviewer's seat to it; a change request knocks it back, visibly unlike an approval. An approved one waits at the merge seat, so the queue in front of the human is drawn as it was. Merged, it lands as one square in its day's column of a strip along the bottom. The strip's day labels and the caption come from the record. Under the pointer, a square or a pull request in flight names itself (number, title, author, reviewers, time to merge) and a seat names its share of the window.
   - A frame is a function of the record and the clock: no state accumulates, so the replay loops, seeks and tests exactly. The first frame starts late in the window, so the strip is already dense; after the last merge the scene holds, then starts over.
   - Still (`setMotion`): the end state, drawn once and again only when an input changes.
   - Quiet (`setQuiet`): nothing is drawn under the rects the host names.
   - The buffer follows `devicePixelRatio`. Colours arrive from the host; the scene lays itself out around the statement the host names (`blocks` nothing stands in, `bands` no seat stands in). The record's index, the layout and an item's place at a minute are pure static functions.
   - `getStats` answers what specs read.
2. **`src/app/roundtable/Canvas.mjs`, `Neo.app.roundtable.Canvas`.** The host: hands the renderer its record (`record`, or a file through `recordUrl`), its look, whether it is still, and the statement (`blockIds`, `bandIds`), which it measures as `AgentOS.view.home.Canvas` does today and measures again when one of those components changes its size.
3. **The Portal's hero mounts it.** `hero/Canvas.mjs` extends the engine host, loads `apps/portal/resources/data/record-week.json` and names the hero's lines as quiet. `apps/portal/canvas/HomeCanvas.mjs` and `Helper#importHomeCanvas` (no caller) are deleted.
4. **`buildScripts/docs/recordWeek.mjs`** writes that file from the GitHub API for one public repository and seven whole UTC days: the window, the seats, one row per merged pull request (number, title, author, opened, merged, reviews with reviewer, state and time), the totals and the caption. A seat is an account whose `authorAssociation` is `OWNER`, `MEMBER` or `COLLABORATOR` and whose login reads `neo-<model>-<name>`; the name and the group come from the login. Every other author enters through the door. Dependabot's pull requests are left out and not counted.
5. **`CANVAS_EXPECTATIONS` gains the row** for `src/canvas/RoundTable.mjs`.

| The Portal hero | #20682; the operator, 2026-11-20 | the round table behind the statement | where the sides do not hold every seat with its name: the strip only | none | frames, a cold read |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with `adr:0018-neo-identity-source-of-truth-model`. The hero sentence and the 28 phrases are untouched; the canvas writes names, dates and counts from the record and no identity statement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1, the picture is the record.** The committed feed is the generator's output; a unit spec feeds the transform a recorded API answer and asserts seats, groups, the door, the left-out bot rows and the totals; the PR shows the feed's totals beside an independent `gh` count for the same window.
- [ ] **AC-2, public sources only.** The generator reads one public repository through the GitHub API and nothing else; the file holds numbers, titles, logins, times and review states.
- [ ] **AC-3, honest at any age.** The caption names the window's two dates. Every number on screen is computed from the feed. No word says live or now.
- [ ] **AC-4, the scene.** At 1440×900 in both neo themes: named seats in their groups' colours, the door, the merge seat, review chords, a change request that reads differently from an approval, and the strip with one square per merged pull request in its day. Frames in the PR: `dev` beside the branch at 1440×900 in both themes and at 390×844.
- [ ] **AC-5, the statement stays first.** `HeroContent.spec.mjs` passes unchanged. At 1440×900, 1440×800 and 900×700 no seat, name, square or caption lies inside a box of the logo, the headline, the sentence or the buttons, read from the renderer's stats against the DOM rects in an e2e spec; nothing is drawn under a quiet rect.
- [ ] **AC-6, it reads.** The pointer over a square shows its pull request's number, title, author, reviewers and time to merge; over a seat, that seat's pull requests and reviews in the window.
- [ ] **AC-7, still and cheap.** Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the scene draws the end state once (`getStats().still`, frames stop counting). A hidden window or a deactivated hero stops the loop. The PR names the measured frame cost at 1440×900 and a pixel ratio of 2.
- [ ] **AC-8, sharp.** A frame at a device scale factor of 2 shows the seat names sharp.
- [ ] **AC-9, small screens.** At 390×844 the scene draws the strip and no names; nothing overlaps the statement.
- [ ] **AC-10, the engine half.** `Neo.canvas.RoundTable` holds no colour and no Portal path; `CANVAS_EXPECTATIONS` has its row; `npm run generate-docs-json` is committed.
- [ ] **AC-11, the look.** The author's read as a stranger and by both halves of the front-door test (does a decider see what he gets, and does he stay) is written in the PR beside one zero-context reader's ten-second read of the after frame, which names seats, reviews and the record unprompted. The home's steward and Screen 1's owner are asked for their read.
- [ ] **AC-12, post-merge.** On the deployed site the feed loads in `dist/production` and the scene draws (Mon Nov 23, the author).

## Out of Scope

- The Agent Institution app's home: an Institution leaf after the pin bump, where `AgentOS.canvas.Home` gives way to this scene on the fleet's own events.
- A feed that refreshes without a deploy, and its place in the content sync: a follow-up. This leaf ships a dated snapshot, regenerated by hand before the cut.
- `learn/guides/advanced/NeuralSwarm.md` teaches its pattern on the renderer this leaf deletes: its rewrite for the round table, or its retirement, is a follow-up.
- A page that renders the institution's work: Discussion #14683 stays parked. This leaf takes its boundaries (public sources only, stale reads as stale, no performance claim) and does not graduate it.
- Opening a pull request from the canvas by a click. Screen 1's continuation cue (#20987). The hero sentence, the phrases and the buttons. Other repositories. A drawing for memory: the record holds no public event for it, and nothing here is invented.

## Avoided Traps

- **A prettier swarm.** Better physics still says nothing a visitor can read.
- **A hand-kept roster.** Seats come from the record's accounts and their association, so a new maintainer appears without an edit.
- **"Live" on a static deploy.** A replay with its dates is true at any age.
- **Adding to the hero's block** (`#20946`: its spacing is the composition). The scene stays behind and around it.
- **A palette in the engine** (`#19261`). The host hands the colours over.
- **The human as a gate.** The merge seat is drawn where the record puts it and named by the record's `mergedBy`.
